author: GitHub
description:
Is AI changing how we describe code as well as how we write it? In this project pick, we explore "The load-bearing vocabulary of Claude" by Louis Abraham. By analyzing over 460,000 GitHub pull request descriptions, the study revealed a growing cluster of AI-associated terms like "load-bearing," "seam," and "non-trivial," along with frequent em dashes.

#AI #Claude #GitHub

author: GitHub
description:
Bring GitHub Copilot directly into your daily team communication. In this episode of GitHub Checkout, Andrea Griffiths and Meagan Cojocar demonstrate how Copilot Cloud Agent works inside Slack and Microsoft Teams. Learn how to create issues, review diffs, render live HTML previews, and analyze repository data without leaving your conversation. Admin setup instructions and enterprise policy requirements are also covered.

— CHAPTERS —

00:00 - Introduction to GitHub Checkout
00:38 - Generating issues and previewing code in Slack
02:33 - How Slack code channels and agent controls work
04:35 - Performing data analysis in Microsoft Teams
06:14 - Multiplayer collaboration and steering AI agents
08:13 - Enterprise settings, repository instructions, and firewall rules
09:07 - Future roadmap and upcoming capabilities
11:22 - Enabling and setting up the integration
